purpose: New whole-character diagonal walk views. Reference cardinal sheets remain unmodified.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art walking sprite sheet for a local top-down game. Reference image: the existing horizontal sheet shows the trainer Red in his red cap, red vest, dark shirt, blue trousers, small yellow backpack; preserve his identity and this authentic small Game Boy Advance pixel-art language. Create newly drawn true three-quarter diagonal views, NOT combinations or slices of the cardinal views. Transparent background. Exact layout: a square 4-column by 4-row grid with 16 equally sized cells, no dividers or labels. Each sprite is independently centered and grounded at exactly the same foot baseline in its cell, full head and feet visible with wide empty margin. Cells 1-8 (first two rows, reading left to right) are eight consecutive equally spaced poses of a smooth walk cycle facing southeast (down-right), showing front and right side naturally in three-quarter perspective. Cells 9-16 (last two rows) are eight consecutive poses of a smooth walk cycle facing northeast (up-right), showing back, yellow backpack, and right side naturally. The head and torso keep the same orientation during each cycle, only arms and legs alternate through genuine contact, down, passing and up poses. Keep the same exact character scale, cap, clothing, proportions and outline throughout all cells. Crisp low-resolution pixel clusters, limited palette, one-pixel dark outline, no anti-aliasing, no ground shadows, no text, no watermark. Both diagonal directions must be visibly different from straight-up, straight-down or side views; whole figure drawn coherently in each direction.
